fullPassage: Many factors contribute to Americans' growing waistlines, but one observation in particular cannot be overlooked: The incidence of obesity has increased in parallel with increasing portion sizes. Consider this: Adults today consume an average of 300 more calories per day than they did in the year 1985. Is this just a coincidence, or do larger portion sizes have something to do with it? In almost every eating situation, we are now confronted by huge portions, which are perceived as "normal" or "a great value." Americans have created the perception that large portion sizes are appropriate, creating an environment of portion distortion. We find portion distortions in restaurants, where the jumbo-sized portions are consistently 250 percent larger than the regular portions. We even find portion distortions in our homes, where the sizes of our bowls and glasses have steadily increased and where the surface area of the average dinner plate has increased 36 percent since 1960. Research shows that people unintentionally consume more calories when offered larger portions. Consuming larger portion sizes can contribute to positive energy balance, which, over time, leads to weight gain and ultimately can result in obesity.

det.korean: 무언가의 형태나 진실을 바꿔 더 이상 정확하지 않게 만드는 행위 = distortion(왜곡)
det.analysis:
❌ ① proportion: '비율'은 형태를 바꾸는 것이 아니라 양적 관계
❌ ② perception: '인식'은 사물을 인지하는 것이지 변형하는 것이 아님
✅ ③ distortion: '왜곡'은 형태/진실을 변형하는 행위라는 정의와 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ consumption: '소비'는 사용/섭취하는 행위이지 변형이 아님
det.tip: distortion = distort(왜곡하다)의 명사형 — 사실/형태를 비틀어 바꾸는 것

questions.passage: We find portion distortions in restaurants, where the jumbo-sized portions are __________ (consist) 250 percent larger than the regular portions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 형용사 larger를 수식하므로 부사형이 필요. consist(동사) → consistent(형용사) → consistently(부사). 'consistently 250 percent larger'(일관되게 250% 더 큰)

overlay.excerptSentences: We find portion distortions in restaurants, where the jumbo-sized portions are __________ (consist) 250 percent larger than the regular portions.

questions.passage: Research shows that people __________ (intention) consume more calories when offered larger portions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 동사 consume을 수식하므로 부사형이 필요하고, 문맥상 '의도치 않게'라는 부정 의미 필요. intention(명사) → intentional(형용사) → intentionally(부사) → un + intentionally = unintentionally
det.tip: intention → intentional → intentionally → unintentionally (접두사 un- + 부사)

overlay.excerptSentences: Research shows that people __________ (intention) consume more calories when offered larger portions.

questions.passage: Many factors contribute to Americans' growing waistlines, but one observation in particular cannot be overlooked: The incidence of obesity has increased in parallel with increasing portion sizes. Consider this: Adults today consume an average of 300 more calories per day than they did in the year 1985. Is this just a coincidence, or do larger portion sizes have something to do with it? In almost every eating situation, we are now confronted by huge portions, which are perceived as "normal" or "a great value." Americans have created the perception that large portion sizes are appropriate, creating an environment of portion distortion. We find portion distortions in restaurants, where the jumbo-sized portions are consistently 250 percent larger than the regular portions. We even find portion distortions in our homes, where the sizes of our bowls and glasses have steadily increased and where the surface area of the average dinner plate has increased 36 percent since 1960. Research shows that people unintentionally consume more calories when offered larger portions. Consuming larger portion sizes can contribute to positive energy balance, which, over time, leads to __________ and ultimately can result in obesity.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 양의 에너지 균형이 시간이 지나면 ____로 이어진다
det.analysis:
✅ ① weight gain: '체중 증가'는 양의 에너지 균형의 결과이자 비만 직전 단계 ←정답
❌ ② weight loss: '체중 감소'는 에너지 과잉이라는 맥락과 반대
❌ ③ muscle growth: '근육 성장'은 글에서 언급되지 않은 내용
❌ ④ better health: '더 나은 건강'은 비만으로 귀결되는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: positive energy balance → weight gain → obesity 순서
